things that add up.

You bring your day. Bloom helps you see it a little more clearly.

01 / EAT WITH AWARENESS

Your plate, made clearer.

Log a meal, review a photo with optional AI, or add ingredients yourself. See calories and nutrients from the portions you confirm.

Photo suggestions. Your final say.
02 / KEEP SHOWING UP

A little movement counts.

A walk, a workout, or your own kind of activity. Record your minutes, add a note, and build a picture of your routine.

Your pace. Your kind of progress.
03 / NOTICE YOUR PROGRESS

See the bigger picture.

Keep food, water, movement and goals together. Look back at what you logged, notice patterns, and make space for small changes.

A clearer day, one entry at a time.
A SIMPLE START

Less setting up.
More getting on with it.

  1. 01

    Make yourself at home.

    Open a guest journal or create your own password-protected local account.

  2. 02

    Add a little of your day.

    A meal, a glass of water, a few active minutes. Start with what matters to you.

  3. 03

    Come back to your progress.

    Your entries stay in this browser. Download a backup whenever you want to keep a copy or move devices.

PERSONAL MEANS PERSONAL

Your journal. Your own little space.

Saved on your device, with guest access and optional encrypted accounts. No automatic cloud sync. Online photo analysis happens only when you choose it.

Local by default.
